companies.name: monday.com

companies.name: Optimove
companies.note: EU-hosted Greenhouse board (job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io page domain). Live-verified: the standard global boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/optimove/jobs endpoint works fine and returns the real 9-job list — Greenhouse's EU data residency only affects the public page domain, not the read-only JSON API, which has no separate EU domain (boards-api.eu.greenhouse.io does not resolve). ats_region is recorded for documentation/future-proofing; it currently has no effect on which domain GreenhouseAdapter actually calls.

companies.name: Mobileye
